scope: New site IDs only, relative to the audit baseline commit. No production, baseline sites, frozen passes, coordinates, dates or decisions changed.

coverage_method: Enumerated every site ID absent from the exact baseline commit; baseline sites excluded from corrections.
Screened every new facility name, country/entity list, exact-coordinate duplicate, shared OSM feature reference and all new-versus-any pairs within 2.5 km.
Inspected accepted A/B scope and site evidence for all proposed metadata corrections and duplicate/nearby-feature concerns.
Preserved one-entity Cyprus Green Line and Georgia ABL labels; no unsupported second country introduced.

The accepted road facility is Namibian Ariamsvlei opposite Nakop, South Africa; other Namibian neighbours are outside this facility.
The accepted facility is Namibian Noordoewer opposite South African Vioolsdrif; the separately accepted Vioolsdrif source reconstruction confirms the opposite controls.

Both passes expressly identify Hilacondji/Sanveecondji on the Benin–Togo frontier; Ghana and Burkina Faso are outside this facility.

Both passes identify Dracenovac–Spiljani on the Montenegro–Serbia frontier; Bosnia and Herzegovina belongs to the wider freight campaign, not this passenger-inclusive extension site.

Both independent reconstructions explicitly identify the San Miguel international road bridge between Colombia and Ecuador. The single-country national-order parent label omits its counterpart and cannot describe this facility.

exact_duplicate_corrections.action: Coordinator may relink the newer binding to the earlier accepted site ID and remove redundant site; no geometry/date/scope alteration.

same_facility_followup.finding: Same Peru-side Santa Rosa facility represented by a building and vehicle-control node. Both A reconstructions instead approve Chilean Chacalluta and explicitly leave Santa Rosa unbound; this is an independent-control-side disagreement, not an automatic merge.
same_facility_followup.action: No coordinate averaging, baseline change or automatic merge; root handles the underlying decisions.

known_root_handled_duplicate.action: Root already owns correction; preserve baseline site.

nearby_distinct_or_reviewed_sites.assessment: Distinct modes and structures: road International Bridge I versus international railway bridge.
Distinct selected features: baseline Milak road-control terminal versus Abresham road bridge. Same paired route does not make a terminal and bridge identical.
Distinct selected features: baseline boundary-road junction versus Honduran customs node about 610 m inland. Shared nearby-source references are not duplicate selected coordinates.
Opposite-side road controls: Greek Evzoni and North Macedonian Bogorodica. No merger proposed.
Distinct sovereign-side controls: Namibian Noordoewer and South African Vioolsdrif across Orange River. Both accepted reconstructions explicitly preserve the side difference.

consumer_impact.finding: Original cause was countries:e.countries. Root now supports candidate.countries for creation and metadata refresh of audited additions; the fallback remains event countries. All reviewed facility-specific corrections have explicit pairs. Do not mechanically force every site to two countries: Cyprus Green Line and Georgia ABL sites legitimately retain one entity.
Site countries are displayed in crossing-source card subtitles and included in the text searched by the crossing-country search.
Site countries are copied into each generated GeoJSON point; full source geography is also published in crossing-map-review.json.
Top-level GIS countries come from event countries and should remain unchanged. geometry_provenance serializes the location object, so erroneous site countries also appear inside that metadata.
Map record search/filtering uses event countries and explicit phase/site IDs, not the site countries property.
Map symbols and record groups are keyed by location ID. Duplicate facility IDs can split records and produce overlapping location choices; country metadata does not set geometry or symbol styling.

Analysis projection retains events only, without crossing geometry; country/region filtering and duration arithmetic use event fields. Correcting site countries alone does not change analysis counts or dates.

additional_primary_identity_sources.finding: Official EU post list groups Kena/Gudagojis and the named eastern road posts under Lithuania–Belarus; Kybartai/Nesterov railway is under Lithuania–Russian Federation. Used for geographic identity only.
Ministry independently identifies Lavoriskes, Raigardas and remaining Medininkai/Salcininkai as Belarus border road posts.

final_validation.final_addition_result: Both A/B locate the Greek inland EO20/EO22 junction serving Albania frontier approaches; Greece/Albania metadata is consistent. No country, ID or geometry correction proposed.
